I sat down with Jim Curtis, transformational coach and author of The Book of Possibility, to talk about the beliefs that shape how we see ourselves and the world around us. One of those beliefs is that we have to continually prove we’re worthy of love. But what if we didn’t? What if we could simply show up, be ourselves, and enjoy the relationships we’ve worked so hard to build? 🎧 Listen to the full episode of A Bit of Optimism wherever you get your podcasts.
